scope: All ordinary tree isomorphism classes of order 14 at p=6 satisfying x(T)+2<=6 and 18<2alpha(T)+1.

replay.adaptation: Executed a scratch copy with the order loop restricted from (14,15) to (14,). The copied forest24.py and inputs/ordinary_tree_checked.py were used from the same scratch replay tree; sealed evidence was not modified.

checks: Generator asserted unique centroid codes and the pinned order-14 free-tree class count.
The tree-DP polynomial was compared against packed generator coefficients at ranks 0 through 8.
Eligibility used the full tree polynomial and first strict descent, including terminal zero extension; guards were x+2<=6 and 18<2alpha+1.
For each eligible class, literal vertex-subset counts were independently computed on the tree and every distinct deletion universe needed for the original leaf selector and summands.
For each row, subset replay matched the favorable leaf list and the complete aggregate, retaining distinct leaf tags even when supports coincide.
The exact finite LP claim follows because a convex combination of 240 column values has maximum at most -222, while a listed realizable column attains -222.
limitations: This is bounded evidence for order 14 and p=6 only; it does not establish other first-shell orders, variable p, or the universal primary claim.
The replay is independent at the arithmetic and subset-count level but reuses the pinned centroid generator; the finite class-generation boundary is not a structural proof for larger orders.
